name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text:
Do it: Auto-apply whitespace-only patches to third-party dependencies using Pret.

Whitespace-only patches are safe, reversible, and solve real problems like inconsistent indentation or trailing spaces that break tooling. The trade-off is extra CI noise from trivial commits, but that’s outweighed by cleaner code and fewer manual fixes. Pret is battle-tested for this—no risk of logic changes. Ship it.

name: Gauge
text: Pret’s dry-run can misread whitespace that *matters*—like Python’s indentation-sensitive syntax. A safer alternative is to flag these issues in CI without auto-applying, letting humans resolve them where context is critical. Settle it by testing a sample of third-party deps with Pret and comparing the dry-run’s accuracy against manual review.
